"Levitate" is a song by the British band Hadouken!
It was released on 20 January 2013 as the fifth single from their third studio album Every Weekend (2013).
It was produced by British duo Loadstar and Dutch bass music trio Noisia (under their Nightwatch alias).
The discography of Hadouken!, a Leeds-based grindie band, currently consists of three studio albums, six EPs, ten singles, and twenty two music videos.
